All.name: Scope
All.description:
You put a custom designed scope on your runegun.
It's range is increased by 2 tiles.
When you take the Aim Combat Maneuver with it the bonus increases to +3.

All.name: Revolving Barrel
All.description:
You've designed a system to allow you load multiple bullets at once in your runegun
Your Runegun has the Magazine 3 trait, allowing you to fire three times before reloading.
The reload action still only reloads one bullet, so you will need to spend three actions to fully reload

All.name: Agile Gunsmith
All.description:
You've modified your pistol to be a quick and graceful weapon.
You're Runegun Pistol has the Agile trait

All.name: Integrated Bayonet
All.description:
You have integrated an bayonet into the design of your runegun.
Your runegun has an in built bayonet, which loses the -1 attack penalty.
It can be retracted or extended from your runegun as an action
It benefits from all the Runes you apply to your runegun.

All.name: Bigger Booms
All.description:
You can increase the impact of your cannon
When firing your runegun you can spend 5 mana to make it deal an additional dice of damage
After using this you become Off-Guard 2 until the start of your next turn or until you take an action to steady yourself

All.name: Silencer
All.description:
You've added a sound rune absorbing rune to make your runegun more subtle.
When firing your runegun you can spend 2 mana to ignore the Loud trait

All.name: Mighty Blast
All.description:
You have modified your runegun so you can project a cone of thundering force in front of you
When firing your runegun you can spend 4 mana to deal a d8 of thunder damage in a 3 tile cone

All.name: Blastback
All.description:
You can let the power of your weapon blast you back away from your foes.
When you strike with your Runegun Cannon you can choose to move back 1 tile away from the direction you fired.
Enemies have disadvantage on Reactive Strikes provoked by this movement

All.name: Fatal Bullets
All.description:
Your custom bullets are even more deadly than normal
Increase the deadly damage dice of your runegun by 2. (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, d10 to d12)
Your proficiency level in crafting, intimidation or survival increases (max Expert).

All.name: Six Shot
All.description:
You've enhanced your barrel capacity.
Your Runegun now has the Magazine 6 trait.

All.name: Harness Discharged Mana
All.description:
You can empower your Bayonet with discharged mana from the runework of your runegun.
If you make a bayonet attack as the next action after firing your Runegun it gains a +1 bonus and does and extra d6 damage

All.name: Stabilizer
All.description:
When stabilized and aiming at stationary targets you almost can't miss
If you've taken the Aim action and your target hasn't moved since last turn the bonus increases to +5

All.name: Fan The Hammer
All.description:
You can quickly unload your bullets into a target
You can have the Fan The Hammer activity.
Fan The Hammer, 1 Focus Point, Two Actions 
 - Attack a target within your runegun's first range increment. Keep attacking until you have made four attacks or your Magazine runs out

All.name: True Deadliness
All.description:
One Shot, One Kill
Further increase the deadly damage dice for your runegun. (d8 to d10, d10 to d12, d12 to 2d8)
Your proficiency level in crafting, intimidation or survival increases (max Master).

All.name: Biggest Booms
All.description:
None can dwarf your blasts
When using Bigger Booms you can spend 15 mana to deal two additional dice of damage instead.

All.name: Magazine Reload
All.description:
With a complex mechanical system you can now reload your entire magazine at once
You can spend two actions to reload your runegun magazine
